message.content: Morning. I’m staring at a blank screen and my brain is still in wedding mode. I need to send a quick update to the Miller family about their final invoice, but I keep second-guessing the tone. Can you draft something professional but warm? They’re lovely people, just a bit anxious about the budget.

content.text:
Happy Sunday, Thandiwe. Let’s get that out of the way so you can relax. Here is a draft for you:

Subject: Final Invoice - The Miller Wedding

Hi Sarah and David,

It was an absolute pleasure capturing your special day. I hope you’re both enjoying the quiet moments after the whirlwind! Attached is the final invoice for the photography services. Please let me know if you have any questions regarding the payment details or the album delivery timeline.

Warmly,
Thandiwe

message.content: That looks perfect. Thanks. Oh, while you have it, can you also update my payment details in my CRM? I’ve been meaning to do it for weeks but keep forgetting. I switched banks a while back, so the old FirstRand Bank details are gone. It’s Capitec Bank now. The account number is 1982736450.

content.text: I’ve updated your profile in the CRM with your new Capitec Bank details and account number 1982736450. I’ve also flagged the old FirstRand Bank info for archiving so you don’t accidentally use it again. Is there anything else you need to tidy up before you head out?

message.content: Actually, yes. I need to book my next physio session. My knee has been acting up from all the crouching for food shoots. I used to go to Cape Town Physio, but that place closed down last year. I need to find the new one.

content.text: I’ve located the new clinic for you. It’s called Wellness Hub. They have an opening this Wednesday at 10:00 AM. Shall I book that slot for you?

message.content: Yes, please do. And while you’re at it, can you check my calendar for next week? I have that shoot with the food blog on Tuesday, so I need to make sure I’m not double-booked. Also, I need to buy groceries. I’m running low on avocados and spinach for the smoothies I make for Bongo and me.

content.text: I’ve booked your physio appointment at Wellness Hub for Wednesday at 10:00 AM. I’ve also checked your calendar for next week; you’re clear on Tuesday after 2:00 PM for the food blog shoot. For your grocery list, I’ve added 4 avocados and 2 bags of baby spinach to your weekly shopping list. Would you like me to send this to your phone for when you go to the store later?

message.content: Yes, please send it. And one more thing, can you remind me to pay the rent? I always forget which day it’s due. I know it’s 12500 ZAR, but I need to make sure the transfer goes through before the weekend.

content.text: I’ve set a reminder for you to pay your rent of 12500 ZAR on Friday morning to ensure it clears before the weekend. Your grocery list has been sent to your phone. Is there anything else you need help with today?

message.content: No, that’s everything. Thanks. I’m going to put Bongo on a walk and then try to nap. It’s been a long week.

content.text: You’re welcome, Thandiwe. Enjoy your walk with Bongo and the rest. Let me know if you need anything else.
